config:
system
 host-name             manager
 system-ip             1.1.1.1
 site-id               1
 admin-tech-on-failure
 no vrrp-advt-with-phymac
 sp-organization-name  example-sdwan-lab
 organization-name     example-sdwan-lab
 vbond 192.0.2.11
 aaa
  auth-order      local radius tacacs
  usergroup all
  !
  usergroup basic
   task system read
   task interface read
  !
  usergroup global
  !
  usergroup netadmin
  !
  usergroup network_operations
   task system read
   task interface read write
   task policy read write
   task routing read write
  !
  usergroup operator
   task system read
   task interface read
   task policy read
   task routing read
   task security read
  !
  usergroup security_operations
   task system read
   task interface read
   task routing read
   task security read write
  !
  usergroup tenantadmin
  !
  user admin
   password                  $6$REDACTED-HASH-ADMIN
   last-password-change-time 2026-10-23T00:00:00-00:00
  !
  user mcp-ro
   password    $6$REDACTED-HASH-RO
   description "cat-sdwan-mcp operator"
   group       all global operator
  !
  user mcp-rw
   password    $6$REDACTED-HASH-RW
   description "cat-sdwan-mcp netadmin"
   group       all global netadmin
  !
  ciscotacro-user true
  ciscotacrw-user true
 !
 logging
  disk
   enable
  !
 !
 ntp
  parent
   no enable
   stratum 5
  exit
 !
!
vpn 0
 interface eth1
  ip address 192.0.2.10/24
  tunnel-interface
   allow-service dhcp
   allow-service dns
   allow-service icmp
   allow-service sshd
   allow-service netconf
   no allow-service ntp
   no allow-service stun
   allow-service https
  !
  no shutdown
 !
 ip route 0.0.0.0/0 192.0.2.254
!
vpn 512
 interface eth0
  ip address 198.51.100.10/18
  no shutdown
 !
 ip route 0.0.0.0/0 198.51.100.1
!
